title: 360~480kW Distributed Charger
description: Explore Energy Savers' 360~480kW Distributed Charger for efficient, high-speed EV charging solutions designed to meet your energy needs.

blocks.text: Flexible charging brings customers profitability and better user experience

Each of people who participate in EV charging business is a pioneer of carbon neutral, thank for your commitment and actions to the planet, In order to achieve this great enterprise, Sinexcel is fully committed to provide better charging experience, cheaper energy cost and let more people participate in green traveling actively. The flexible distributed charger is designed and manufactured from these user demands.

Flexible charging for different application scenarios: Flexible deploy user terminal, flexible deploy power, adapt to individual application of urban hub, declinational charging hub, highway hub, adapt to vehicle, bus, truck.
Small and attractive: The user terminal has small footprint which can maximize parking area, it also has attractive appearance to provide better esthetics for the charging station.

Low noise: Power bank is the noise resource and can be placed away from users.

Flexible matrix power switching
With flexible matrix power switching technology, vehicle can charge with 100% accurate power requirement and the capacity of power bank can be 100% used. This is the highest operating efficiency.

items.text: What is the flexible matrix power switching 24*20kW power modules in the power bank are split into 12 sets, each set has 2 power modules with 40kW charging power. These 12 sets charging power can be dynamically allocated to user terminals and distribute power according to different charging needs.
items.lead: What is the flexible matrix power switching

items.text: The benefit of matrix power switching In the different SOC periods, requirements of charging power are different. 40kW charging power as a unit to fulfill various charging needs and provide 100% accurate charging power at “maximum power”. Multiple user terminals share one 480kW power bank which makes high efficiency operation of EV charger and EV charger station.

blocks.text: Higher power conversion efficiency to improveprofitability of EVC station

items.text: Power conversion Independent research and development of the power module, equiped with the third generation SiC MOSFET semiconductor with higher efficiency and three-level Vienna topology. The high perfomance of the device and the topology enable the peak efficieny of power module to reach 96.5%.

System active efficiency optimization The distributed charger integrates the distribution system for control of 24pcs power modules in the power bank to ensure 50% load rate of power conversion module and 96% efficiency of the charging system. Compared with 95% efficiency, taking 6 vehicles charge with 80kW as an example, each 480kW EV charger can reduce energy loss of 5.26kWh per hour and is able to save 11519kWh electric energy every year for charging 6 hours a day.
